firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently visited a harbor goes first.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The active-player role moves clockwise. Other players may also act in the Trade & Hire phase after the active player.
